name: Vyrin's Revenge
label: Quest
description: Vyrin's Revenge: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Light! Don't bring things like that into the Lodge... It's unsanitary, unspeakable, un... Un... Unsanitary!
Just get it out of here, will you? No one wants to see your bloody little trophy, really!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Great job, friend! We really showed him! Here, give me the head and I'll take care of it.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thanks for helping me out with my little plan, friend. I've been itching for months to get back at that snooty, stuck-up boy, and I'd say we did a pretty good job! Here, have this, you've earned it.
